records.title: Introduction to Health Economics
records.header: HEOR 340 Introduction to Health Economics (3) SSc
records.text: HEOR 340 Introduction to Health Economics (3) SSc Applies core microeconomic concepts to the study of health care markets and the U.S. health systems. Students use economic models and analytic tools to explore a wide range of topics such as health insurance design, provider incentives, pharmaceutical markets, and current health policy debates. Recommended: ECON 200. Offered: jointly with ECON 344/PHRMSC 330; A.

records.title: Application of Machine Learning in Health Economics and Outcomes Research
records.header: HEOR 452 Application of Machine Learning in Health Economics and Outcomes Research (3)
records.text: HEOR 452 Application of Machine Learning in Health Economics and Outcomes Research (3) Introduction to machine learning methods, focusing on understanding applied literature, gaining hands-on experience with basic analysis to address health outcomes, policy, and economics related questions, and communicating results to a general scientific audience. Provides overview of topics related to using machine learning for medical decision-making, including model evaluation, algorithmic bias, model shift, and simulation modeling. Prerequisite: one 300-level STAT course; recommended: advanced coursework in either statistics, biostatistics, or econometrics; and familiarity with multivariable statistical methods, including linear and logistic regression. Offered: jointly with PHRMSC 433; Sp.
